"'''The Great Leaf Glide / The Harvest Feast'''" is the eighteenth episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season One|first season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney+]] on [[November 8]], [[2023]].<ref name=" More YJA Episodes2" />

==Official description==
''"Younglings learn to sky surf. The Jedi save a feast."''
